content:
maria_cs: FYI — we're seeing recurring ECC / Xid spikes on a subset of GPUs in the eu-west-2 dedicated fleet. Eng recommends draining and replacing 6 cards across 3 hosts. Need customer comms (initial notice + in-flight updates + post-replacement). ETA for replacement: tomorrow 03:00–07:00 UTC. @li_eng can you confirm expected impact for Dedicated vs Private tenants?

li_eng: Quick summary: these are corrected ECC errors escalating to repeated Xid 13/31 entries. If we don't swap, risk moves from intermittent rounding errors to uncorrectable faults and host process crashes. For Dedicated customers we can failover workloads to spare nodes in the same AZ; affected containers will be restarted and reconnect within ~30–90s in most cases. For Redwood Private (air-gapped on-prem) we'll provide a replacement playbook and remote assist, but hardware swap will require customer coordination. For VPC Private where we manage HW we will perform the same swap flow as Dedicated. Logs we saw: `nvidia-smi -q | grep -A 8 Xid` shows repeated Xid 31 bursts tied to one GPU serial.

sam_oncall: Ops checklist I plan to run:
1) cordon the three hosts (kubectl cordon)
2) drain non-critical pods / move reserved customers to spare nodes (kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data)
3) power-cycle and hot-swap GPUs with spares
4) run 12h burn-in + nvlink + memtest; smoke-run serving load;
5) uncordon and monitor.
Estimated customer-visible impact: majority of Dedicated instances should see short restarts (under 2–5 minutes); heavy long-lived streams may see a brief stall. We'll call this proactive maintenance.

eden_pm: Draft notice below — aim for calm, clear, and action-oriented. Avoid words like 'catastrophic' or 'outage'. Include support contact and expected timeline.

maria_cs: ```
Subject: Planned hardware replacement for GPUs in eu-west-2 — action required (proactive maintenance)

Hello —

We’re reaching out with a proactive maintenance notice for a small number of GPU cards in our eu-west-2 dedicated pool that have shown increasing hardware-corrected errors. To avoid service disruptions we will replace affected cards during a scheduled window: TOMORROW 03:00–07:00 UTC.

What to expect
- Impact: Most Dedicated workloads will be failed over to spare capacity and may experience short restarts (typically under 2–5 minutes). If you run long-lived streaming connections, you may see a brief stall during the failover.
- Private deployments: If your deployment is managed by Redwood in a VPC we will perform the swap with the same failover behavior. If you run on-prem, our team will provide a replacement guide and offer remote assistance; swaps must be coordinated with your hardware team.
- No action required for most customers. If you operate latency-sensitive production traffic during the window, reply to this thread and we will schedule a per-customer mitigation plan.

Support
If you have questions or want to request an alternate window, reply here or contact support@redwood.ai and cc your CSM. We will post live updates in this thread during the replacement.

Thanks — Maria (Customer Success)
```

li_eng: Small edits: add a brief technical footnote for customers who want more detail and include the model/serial list for affected cards in the controlled notice (we'll attach privately). Also add that we will keep rolling windows to avoid AZ-wide impact.

sam_oncall: Please add maintenance window exact times and an ops contact. Also recommend we add a short-run rollback plan: if burn-in fails, we'll revert to previous nodes and reattach workloads (expected extra 15–30 min).

maria_cs: Updated draft saved. Who can sign off for sending at T-12 hours? @li_eng @sam_oncall — need LGTM.

li_eng: LGTM from eng side. I'll also prepare the private serials list for CSMs.

sam_oncall: Ops OK — I'll schedule the maintenance and post the auto-scheduled maintenance note.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: eu-west-2 GPU card replacement — 03:00–07:00 UTC (1765580000). Affected hosts: host-032, host-047, host-059. See internal runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-swap

maria_cs: Thanks everyone — sending initial notice to impacted Dedicated customers now. I'll post progress updates in this thread during the window. :rocket:

li_eng: Please attach the diagnostic snippet we used and the recommended post-check commands in the private CSM DM (e.g., `nvidia-smi -q`, `dmesg | grep -i nvidia`, `journalctl -u redwood-inference --no-pager | tail -n 200`).

maria_cs: Will do. Closing loop — will update thread once replacements complete.
